user:
What is the current database schema?
assistant:
The database has the following tables:

- users (id, email, name, created_at)
- posts (id, user_id, title, body, created_at)
- comments (id, post_id, user_id, body, created_at)

Each table has appropriate foreign key constraints.
user:
How do I add a new column?
assistant:
You can add a new column with an ALTER TABLE statement:

```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url TEXT;
```

Make sure to create a migration file for this change.
